# update esbuild

Update `esbuild` — a JS bundler kept in the Go toolset — to v0.8.33; the release notes are the [v0.8.33 tag](https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.8.33). The Go tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so an upgrade is a change of that pin; the same `go generate tools.go` mechanism is already visible in the 2020 build failure [[DOT-83]]. What the author bundled with esbuild is not recorded in the repository.
